storyCards.headline: Treat 'Em Right: A Cultural Moment Captured on Record
storyCards.fact:
Chubb Rock's "Treat 'Em Right" reached #95 on the Billboard Hot 100. Richard Anthony Simpson (born May 28, 1968), also known as Chubb Rock, is a Jamaican-American rapper who released several successful hip hop albums in the late 1980s and early 1990s.

The song peaked at #95 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 2 weeks on the chart.

Treat 'Em Right was released in 1991.
